top1.title: 【2026-11-17】米国、海外経由のAI計算資源利用を対象に輸出規制強化へ
top1.lead1: 米政権は、中国などの企業が海外のAI計算資源を遠隔利用して輸出規制を回避することを防ぐ新規制を準備している。
top1.lead2: 対象の海外データセンター向けAI半導体輸出などに許可を要求。仲介経由の利用も対象とし、運営企業の顧客確認も問われる。

top10.title: [2026-11-17] U.S. to tighten export controls on access to AI computing resources overseas
top10.summary: The U.S. administration is preparing new regulations to prevent companies from China and other countries from remotely accessing overseas computing resources. The rules would require licenses for exports of AI chips and other items to covered data centers.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] OpenAI trials bringing external safety evaluators in-house
top10.summary: OpenAI is hosting external researchers internally to investigate issues such as AI circumventing safeguards. Restrictions remain on access to information and publication of findings.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] FBI warns of misuse of autonomous AI attack tool Artex
top10.summary: The FBI warned that intrusions using the AI tool Artex had occurred across multiple industries. In some cases, it said, less than three hours elapsed from identifying a target to compromising it.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] OpenAI announces child sexual abuse image detector and ChatGPT warning feature
top10.summary: OpenAI will provide eligible companies with a free detector that also supports AI-generated images. It will add warnings and 24-hour account suspensions to ChatGPT.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] Nvidia board reportedly not considering Huang's return as CEO
top10.summary: The Verge, citing CNBC, reported that Nvidia's board is not discussing Huang's return. The board is reportedly focusing on an investigation concerning him.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] Apple tests daily usage limits for advanced Siri and AI features in beta
top10.summary: Apple is reportedly testing daily limits on advanced AI features that use cloud processing. Basic Siri operations will remain free and unlimited.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] Audible helps listeners discover their next book with AI-generated audio introductions
top10.summary: Audible has launched a feature that uses AI voices to introduce a work's themes and praised aspects. It covers selected English-language titles in the U.S. and also incorporates audio from past author interviews and other sources.

top10.title: [2026-11-17] Belfort's voice AI company Tone targets sales and book narration
top10.summary: An interview article. Tone says it is developing sales AI that varies its tone of voice, as well as book narration. The article explicitly states that it has not been able to independently verify the technology's performance.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
